question: What must the practitioner contemplate in the mūlādhāra as the chosen deity?
premises: The locus of practice is the mūlādhāra
The chosen deity is the object of contemplation
inference: In the mūlādhāra one should contemplate the root-knowledge as the chosen deity.
plain_english: In the mūlādhāra one should contemplate the root-knowledge as the chosen deity.
